en: Black‑and‑white illustrated wartime scene showing French soldiers in an intense bayonet charge against German troops wearing spiked pickelhaube helmets. Smoke and explosions fill the background, and the foreground is crowded with bodies and close‑quarters combat in a trench or on a battlefield. At the bottom, printed text reads "LA FURIA FRANÇAISE" with a small publisher's mark and the word "PARIS"; there is also cursive handwriting in ink across the lower margin.
